original: あのさー、思ったんだけど\nみんな髪長過ぎじゃない？
traducao: Say, I've been thinking...\nIsn't everyone's hair way too long?

original: 邪魔になったりしないわけ？
traducao: Doesn't it get in your way?

original: ……邪魔にならない様に結っている
traducao: ...I tie it up so it won't.

original: 俺は、羊飼いの仕事で役立つから\nこのままにしてるんだけど
traducao: It helps me out with my shepherding,\nso I just leave it like this.

original: 羊だぁ？
traducao: Shepherding?

original: ああ
traducao: Yeah.

original: 髪が長いと、\n羊が仲間と間違えてくれて\n結構便利なんだ
traducao: When my hair is long,\nthe sheep mistake me for one of them.\nIt's pretty convenient.

original: はっ、家畜と同類か……。\n結構な事だ
traducao: Hmph. Mistaken for livestock...?\nGood for you.

original: っていうか、そういうお前だって\n髪長ぇじゃねえかよ
traducao: Besides, aren't you the one\nwith long hair too?

original: あたしは女の子だからいーの！
traducao: I'm a girl, so it's totally fine!

original: 性別が関係あるのか……？
traducao: Does gender really matter here...?

original: まぁ、いいじゃねーか。\n個人の趣味嗜好なんざ、\n周りがとやかく言う事じゃねえよ
traducao: Well, who cares?\nPersonal taste isn't something people\naround you need to nitpick over.

original: 珍しく意見が合ったな
traducao: For once, we actually agree.

original: そりゃ、どーも
traducao: Much obliged.

original: ったく。\n変な質問すんなってーの
traducao: Good grief.\nQuit asking weird questions.

original: うー……あんたに言われると\n何か悔しい……
traducao: Ugh... Hearing that from you\njust pisses me off...

original: アーチェは、ハーフエルフなんだよね
traducao: You're a half-elf, right, Arche?

original: うん。\nそうだよ
traducao: Yup.\nThat's right.

original: ハーフエルフは、普通の人間より\nとっても長生きなんだよね？
traducao: Half-elves live much longer than\nregular humans, don't they?

original: ……やっぱり、長い時間を過ごして\n寂しくなったりはする？
traducao: ...Do you ever feel lonely,\nliving through all that time?

original: そりゃあ……ね
traducao: Well... of course.

original: 誰かと仲良くなっても\n結局あたしだけ残されて\n一人ぼっちなんて、しょっちゅう
traducao: Even when I become close friends,\nin the end I'm the only one left,\nall alone. It happens all the time.

original: 怖くなったりしないの？\n人と……一緒にいる事が
traducao: Doesn't it make you scared?\nBeing together... with people?

original: 全然！\n……っていうのは強がりだけどさ
traducao: Not at all!\n...Though I'm just acting tough.

original: みんなと会えたから\n今のあたしがいるんだもん
traducao: Meeting everyone is what made me\nwho I am today, after all.

original: 一緒にいられなくたって\n寂しくたって
traducao: Even if we can't stay together,\neven if it gets lonely...

original: 今を後悔したり\n怯えたりなんてしないよ
traducao: I won't regret the present\nor live in fear.

original: そんなの、あたしらしくないって\n笑われちゃう
traducao: People would laugh at me and say\nthat isn't like me at all!

original: アーチェは強いな……
traducao: You really are strong, Arche...

original: でも、そうだね……。\n何があったって、\n今から目を背けたらだめだよね
traducao: You're right, though...\nNo matter what happens,\nwe can't look away from the present.

original: うん。\n私も元気、出さなきゃ
traducao: Yeah.\nI need to cheer up too!

original: 行こう、○○
traducao: Let's go, ○○!

original: ねえ、空を飛ぶのってどんな感覚なの？\nやっぱり、気持ちいいのかな
traducao: Hey, what does flying feel like?\nDoes it feel really good?

original: ん〜、どうだろ？\nあたしは慣れちゃって、\nあんまり深く考えた事ないけど……
traducao: Hmm, I wonder?\nI'm so used to it that I haven't\nreally thought about it much...

original: 良かったら乗ってみる？
traducao: Would you like to give it a try?

original: いいの？
traducao: Really? May I?

original: もちろん
traducao: Of course

original: ただし、このホウキ\n心の清らかな乙女しか\n乗れないんだよねぇ
traducao: Though, this broom can only be\nridden by maidens pure of heart,\nyou see.

original: そこだけ、ちょ〜っと注意が必要だけど∀
traducao: That's the only tiny catch! :)

original: そう、なんだ……
traducao: I... see...

original: 心が清らかって……難しいね
traducao: Being pure of heart... is hard.

original: え？　\nちょっと、そこで何で沈むわけ？
traducao: Huh?\nWait, why are you getting depressed!?

original: もう、冗談だってば。\n真に受けないでよ〜
traducao: Geez, I was just kidding!\nDon't take it so seriously~

original: 一人ぼっちで生きる、か……
traducao: Living all alone, huh...?

original: 私も、ロックスがいなかったら\n一人ぼっちで生きていかなきゃ\nいけなかった
traducao: If not for Rocks, I would have had\nto live all by myself,\nall alone in this world.

original: それでも……私は生きていけたかな？\n一人でも、まっすぐ未来を\n信じられたかな……
traducao: Even then... could I have survived?\nCould I have believed in the future\nall on my own...?

original: ……ごめんね。\nちょっと考え込んじゃった
traducao: ...Sorry.\nI got a little lost in thought.

original: 誰もが、当たり前に明日や\nその先にある未来を信じて\n生きていける世界……
traducao: A world where anyone can naturally\nbelieve in tomorrow and the future\nlying ahead...

original: そんな世界に、この世界が\nなればいいのにな
traducao: I wish this world could become\na place like that.

original: ううん……
traducao: No...

original: していきたい、よね。\nそんな……あったかい世界に
traducao: We want to make it that way, right?\nInto such a warm and gentle world.

original: カノンノ〜？
traducao: Kanonno~?

original: なになに、どうしたの？\nちょっと目、うるんでない？
traducao: What's up? What's going on?\nAre your eyes a bit teary?

original: そんな事ないよ。\n大丈夫
traducao: Not at all.\nI'm fine.
Right, ○○!

original: 全くもう、どうしてあたしの料理で\n失神する奴が出てくるわけ？
traducao: Seriously, why does anyone have to\npass out from my cooking!?

original: ちゃんと美味しく出来てるのに！
traducao: I made it taste completely fine!

original: アーチェ、気持ちはわかるけれど\nこういう時、自棄を起こしては駄目よ
traducao: Arche, I understand how you feel, but\nyou mustn't act out in despair.

original: 料理に失敗は付き物なのだから\nあまり気にし過ぎるのも良くないわ
traducao: Failures are a natural part of cooking,\nso dwelling on it won't do any good.

original: 私もリフィルと同じ意見ですわ。\n失敗は成功の元とも言いますし\n次に成功すればいいのです
traducao: I agree with Raine.\nThey say failure is the mother of\nsuccess, so you just need to succeed next!

original: 私達も、協力出来る事は\n協力しますから。\nどうか元気をお出しになって
traducao: We shall also help in any way we can.\nSo please, hold your head high and\ncheer up.

original: 三人寄れば文殊の知恵、という\n言葉もあるわね
traducao: As the saying goes, three heads\nare better than one.

original: 私達の場合、一人ひとりは\n決して卓越した\n料理の技術はないけれど
traducao: In our case, while none of us alone\npossesses extraordinary culinary\nskills,

original: 協力し合う事で、より良いものを\n作り出す事は十二分に可能だと思うの
traducao: by working together, we are more than\ncapable of creating something better.

original: リフィル……ナタリア……。\nありがとう……
traducao: Raine... Natalia...\nThank you so much...

original: ……よーし！　三人でとびっきり\n美味しい料理を作って\nみんなをあっと驚かせてやろうね！！
traducao: ...All right! The three of us will make\nthe most delicious feast ever, and knock\neveryone's socks right off!!

original: わっ！！！
traducao: Boo-baaam!!!

original: うわぁっ！？
traducao: Waaah!?

original: あはははー。\nひっかかったひっかかったぁ
traducao: Ahahaha!\nYou fell for it! Hook, line, and sinker!

original: い、いきなり何するの
traducao: W-What did you do that for out of nowhere?

original: えっ？　\nそ、そんな\n涙目になんなくたっていいじゃん
traducao: Huh?\nY-You don't have to get all\nteary-eyed about it, you know!

original: ちょっとしたイタズラよ、イタズラ∀\nルカって何か絡みやすいっていうかさぁ
traducao: It was just a little prank!\nRuca, you're just so easy to tease!

original: イタズラ……そっか、そうだよね
traducao: A prank... I see. Of course.

original: 昔からよくされるんだ。\n……僕、暗いから……
traducao: People have always done that to me.\n...Because I'm so gloomy...

original: へっ？\nいや別に、そういうつもりじゃ
traducao: Huh?\nN-No, I didn't mean it like that...

original: いいんだ、僕なんて……\nイリアにもいつもいじられてるし\nぐすっ……
traducao: It's fine. Someone like me...\nIria picks on me all the time anyway...\n*sniff*...

original: ちょ、何で泣いてんの？
traducao: Wait, why are you crying!?

original: も〜〜。\nあたしが悪かったってばぁ！
traducao: Come on~!\nI'm sorry, all right!?

original: アーチェのそのリボン、可愛いわね。\n髪の色とよく合っているわ
traducao: That ribbon is quite lovely, Arche.\nIt matches your hair color nicely.

original: えへへ、そお？\nありがと∀
traducao: Ehehe, you think so?\nThanks! :)

original: このリボンはさ、友達がくれたんだ
traducao: A friend of mine gave me this ribbon.

original: その子は今、遠い所にいて\n会えないんだけど……
traducao: She's far away right now,\nso I can't see her, but...

original: そう……
traducao: I see...

original: あ……でも、これがあると\nいつもその子と一緒にいるみたいな\nそんな気がするんだよね
traducao: Ah... but whenever I have this,\nit feels like she's always with me,\nyou know?

original: もう、お守りみたいなものなのね
traducao: It is like a good-luck charm to you.

original: うん……そうかも
traducao: Yeah... I guess so.

original: 一生のうちで\nそういった友達に出会えたのは\nとても幸運な事よ
traducao: To meet such a friend\nin the course of one's lifetime\nis a truly fortunate blessing.

original: ……大切にしなくてはね
traducao: ...You must cherish it deeply.

original: ……うん、わかってる
traducao: ...Yeah, I know.

original: わかってるんだけどさ……。\nたまに……
traducao: I know, but...\nSometimes...

original: たまに？
traducao: Sometimes?

original: う、ううん、何でもない！
traducao: N-No, it's nothing!

original: わかってはいても\n心では割り切れない……
traducao: Even when one understands intellectually,\nthe heart cannot always accept it...

original: 人より多く、別れを経験する\nハーフエルフの宿業なのかしらね……
traducao: Enduring far more partings than others...\nIs this the karmic lot of a half-elf...?

original: ねえ、アーチェ！\nボクの指、好きなの握ってみてヨ
traducao: Hey, Arche!\nPick any of my fingers and squeeze it!
Your fingers~?

original: なになに、握ると何かあるわけ？
traducao: What is this? Does something happen?

original: えへへ、ちょっとした心理テストなんだ〜。\nほらほら、早く選んで！
traducao: Ehehe, it's a little personality test~\nCome on, come on, hurry and choose!

original: う〜ん……、じゃあ……
traducao: Hmm... Well then...

original: 中指に決〜〜めたっ！
traducao: I pick the middle finger!

original: あれ、ユージーンと一緒だ
traducao: Huh? That's the same one as Eugene.

original: ちぇ、つまんないの〜
traducao: Aww, that's no fun~

original: ちょっとちょっと、\nわざわざ人にやらせておいて\nそれはないんじゃない？
traducao: Hey, hold on a second!\nYou went out of your way to make me do it\nand that's all you have to say!?

original: あっ、じゃあさ。\nせっかくだし、あたしにもやり方教えてよ
traducao: Oh, I know!\nTeach me how to do the quiz too!

original: アーチェも心理テストやりたいの？
traducao: You want to give the quiz too, Arche?

original: うん！　\nだって何か面白そうじゃん♪\n使うのは右手？　左手？
traducao: Yup!\nBecause it sounds pretty fun!\nDo I use the right hand or the left?

original: う〜ん、わかんない！\nどっちでもいいんじゃない？
traducao: Hmm, I don't know!\nEither one is fine, isn't it?

original: え〜、何それ？\nちょっと適当過ぎなんじゃん？
traducao: Whaaat? What kind of answer is that?\nAren't you being way too careless?

original: ボクも人から教わっただけなんだ。\nだから詳しい事は、\nよくわからないんだヨ
traducao: I only learned it from someone else.\nSo I don't really know all\nthe fine details, you see!

traducao: Normal.\n
